_note: Chord Lab mood map (docs/chord-lab-prd.md L19): loops to plot besides the app's ten progressions (data/progressions.json). Each is a list of degrees from data/chord-moves.json (bIII, iv, bVI, bVII are borrowed from the parallel minor); the map places it by lib/lab/mood.ts (brightness and restlessness), so there are no hand-set coordinates to drift. The map shows as many as fit with every name legible and no dot far from its true place (docs/chord-lab-prd.md L19 asked for about 20: with names that must never overlap and room kept for the four corner labels, twelve fit); scripts/verify-lab.ts enforces both.
